verdict.line: You lose when Death's Grasp drags you into an all-in; you win by poking from outside 700 range and never letting Morde land three hits.

brief.thesis: Morde has no gap-closer except Death's Grasp, so the entire lane is decided by whether you let that pull connect. The 49.9% head-to-head over 1228 games with OP.GG grading Morde ahead in lane and solo kills reflects a matchup where Teemo wins the poke war at range but loses badly the moment he's grabbed and forced to trade point-blank.

theirWindow.when: Death's Grasp is up and you're close
theirWindow.what: Back off past 700 range entirely. If he lands the pull he follows with Q (Obliterate) and autos, and three landed hits trigger his Darkness Rise passive for bonus damage and move speed, snowballing the trade hard against you.

yourWindow.when: Death's Grasp just went on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and poke freely with Q (Blinding Dart) and autos. Without his pull Morde has to walk 675+ range to use Q (Obliterate), so you get free E (Toxic Shot) stacks while he closes distance.

start.why: 51.9% win rate over 1144 games and the 68.5% pick rate make it the standard choice — the extra sustain and mana let you poke with Q (Blinding Dart) and autos every time he walks up without running dry.

boots.why: 53.8% win rate over 759 games. The flat move speed matters more than magic resist here because your whole game plan is staying outside Death's Grasp's 700 range, and Swiftness also resists the slow if he does connect.

core.why: 58.3% win rate over 396 games as the top path. The attack speed and proc let you apply E (Toxic Shot) stacks faster while you're still kiting rather than standing in his face.
Burn damage rewards your poison poke pattern and punishes Morde for using W (Indestructible) to tank through it, since the damage-over-time keeps ticking past his shield window.
Completes the 36.8%-pick core path and adds the burst you need to actually punish him during the short window after his Death's Grasp is on cooldown.

situational.when: you're ahead and poking him low enough to look for kills
the game goes long and you need more attack speed to keep E (Toxic Shot) stacks flowing while kiting

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive ranged autos before he closes distance, and the damage amplify punishes any trade you win with E (Toxic Shot) ticking on top.

summoners.why: 89.3% pick rate at a 50.8% win rate. Flash is your only answer to Death's Grasp once it's already connected, and Ignite punishes his W (Indestructible) healing by denying the shield-and-heal reset during a poke trade.

playing.title: Hold max range at all times
playing.detail: Morde's Death's Grasp reaches 700 range, further than your own 680-range Q and autos, so standing at your max attack range does not guarantee safety. Give yourself extra buffer, not exactly your attack range.

playing.title: Blind before he commits
playing.detail: Fire Q (Blinding Dart) the moment he starts walking up to trade. It has an 8s cooldown so you can use it almost every approach, and it denies the autos he needs toward his Darkness Rise passive.

playing.title: Never trade inside his pull
playing.detail: If Death's Grasp is up and you're within 700 range, leave. Getting pulled means eating Q (Obliterate) and autos for free while he builds toward his passive damage-and-speed aura.

playing.title: Punish immediately after his E whiffs or lands
playing.detail: Death's Grasp's cooldown is 16s at rank 1, dropping to 8s at rank 5 — track which rank he's likely at by level and poke hard in the window right after he uses it.

playing.title: Pre-place mushrooms at jungle entrances
playing.detail: R (Noxious Trap) only costs a 1s cooldown to place, so lay them in river and brush early to get vision of ganks and to zone his Realm of Death setups rather than saving them for a 1v1 you can't force.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-in windows
playing.detail: Realm of Death isolates you in a 1v1 and steals your stats on a kill, so play it safe around level 6 and his subsequent ult windows (140s cooldown at rank 1) rather than extending trades.

playing.title: Use Move Quick to disengage, not chase
playing.detail: W (Move Quick) builds passive speed until you're struck by him or a turret, and sprinting isn't interrupted by being struck for a short time — use it to create distance after any skirmish, since you have no reliable way to run him down.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from real OP.GG games on patch 16.19.1, including the 49.9% Teemo-vs-Mordekaiser head-to-head over 1228 games; the mechanical reasoning about Death's Grasp range, Darkness Rise stacking, and trade timing is this brief's own tactical judgment.
